definitions.short: properly, something poured out, i.e. a libation ; also a molten image ; by implication, a prince (as anointed )
definitions.full: H5257. nciyk I. [ נָסִיךְ ] noun masculine 1 libation ; 2 molten image ; — 1 suffix נְסִיכָם יֵין wine of their drink-offering Deut 32:38 . 2 molten image , suffix נְסִכֵיהֶם Dan 11:8 . II. [ נָסִיךְ ] noun masculine prince ; — plural construct נְסִיכֵי Josh 13:21 ; Ezek 32:30 ; Micah 5:4 ; suffix נְסִיכֵמוֺ Psa 83:12 . נִסְמָן see סמן .
